issue_title: Expose archived_at in the widget API response
issue_body:
The archive endpoint sets `archived_at`, but `GET /widgets/{id}` does not return it, so clients cannot tell an archived widget from an active one.

Include `archived_at` (RFC 3339, or null when not archived) in every widget response.

plan.summary: Include archived_at in the widget API response.

approach.description: Select archived_at in the widget store queries.
Add the ArchivedAt field (*time.Time, json:"archived_at") to the widgetResponse struct in internal/api/widgets.go.
Add archived_at (nullable date-time) to the Widget schema in api/openapi.yaml.

verification.test_strategy: Handler tests: an archived widget's GET /widgets/{id} body carries a non-null RFC 3339 archived_at; an active widget's carries null.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR. The change is additive; no data migration needs reversing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The code in approach step 2 was written: widgetResponse has an ArchivedAt field.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Step 2 is the load-bearing change, so the criterion checks it was done.

acceptance_criteria.statement: GET /widgets/{id} for an active widget returns archived_at: null.
api/openapi.yaml's Widget schema declares archived_at as a nullable date-time.

risks_and_assumptions: All widget responses go through toWidgetResponse, so one change covers every endpoint.

catching_examples.note: ac-step-two-done restates approach step 2 instead of an observable outcome; it would pass even if the handler never populates the field.
One criterion restates the approach (the step-2 struct field exists); it should assert the response the issue asks for.

non_catching_examples.note: The OpenAPI change should give an example value for the new timestamp field.
No criterion verifies an ARCHIVED widget's response carries a non-null timestamp.
Selecting the extra column in every query slightly widens the row scan; negligible.
Approach step 4 must also update docs/api.md.
Approach step 2 should make ArchivedAt a pointer so a null archived_at serializes.
Test that toWidgetResponse populates ArchivedAt for the list endpoint too.
